ansioluettelot.olen_luotettava_ja_omaalo: I am a reliable and proactive contributor with versatile experience in both practical logistics and technical problem solving. As an early-morning delivery worker, I have learned to value precision and optimize processes, and I have excellent visual-spatial memory. In my free time I design, code, and maintain extensive web infrastructures and servers. I am looking for work where I can use my ability to understand large systems and quickly learn new ones – whether it is source code or complex route maps.
ansioluettelot.olen_suunnitellut_ja_rake: I have independently designed and built a comprehensive web infrastructure around my own domains. I am comfortable with both frontend and backend development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP) and understand deeply how systems communicate with each other. In addition to development work, I handle the setup and maintenance of my own server environment (for example VPS solutions and cloud storage) as well as version control through GitHub. Security, privacy, and process automation are built-in ways of working for me, not just add-on features.
ansioluettelot.olen_valmis_tarttumaan_uu: I am ready to take on new challenges and bring a strong work ethic with me. I would gladly come to an interview to tell you more about how I could benefit your organization.

ansioluettelot.työskentelen_tällä_hetkel: I currently work as an early-morning delivery worker, which has taught me resilience under pressure and seamless routine management. I can optimize driving routes independently and make sure deliveries arrive precisely on schedule, even in demanding weather conditions and during night shifts.
